name: entity-source-code-modal
goal: Every catalog type opens actual source code for the selected revision in the shared modal; old or unavailable source remains explicit and closing preserves the current view.

evidence: All catalog kinds, source modal and existing Source tab acceptance are documented in specification/features/planned/entity-source-code-modal.md. Source belongs to the selected committed tree; missing text stays explicit.

Existing unified Source coverage asserted only ownership paths, not code. Extended the standard catalog fixture and browser scenarios, Desktop bridge cases and history-index Git-byte assertions. Added reusable source-history coverage for directory ownership, deduplication, binary/missing gaps, Unicode and dirty-tree isolation.
